title: Spiral staircase generator
purpose: Generate a spiral staircase mesh with wedge treads, a central column, balusters and a helical handrail from rise, turn and radius parameters. Use it for towers, lofts and level blockouts.

parameters.name: total_height
parameters.description: Floor to the top of the last tread.

parameters.name: turn_degrees
parameters.description: Total rotation from the first tread to the end of the last.

parameters.name: inner_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the central column, where the treads start.

parameters.name: outer_radius
parameters.description: Outer radius of the treads; must exceed inner_radius by at least 0.2 m.

parameters.name: arc_segments
parameters.description: Segments along the outer arc of each tread and of the handrail per tread.

parameters.name: column_sides
parameters.description: Sides of the central column prism.

parameters.name: handrail
parameters.description: Add a square-section helical handrail and one baluster per tread.

parameters.name: rail_height
parameters.description: Height of the handrail above the tread nosing line.

parameters.name: clockwise
parameters.description: Climb clockwise seen from above instead of counter-clockwise.

outputs.description: One mesh object named Spiral Stairs with a UVMap layer; origin at the column base.

limits: One mesh object made of separate closed solids that touch but are not merged, so booleans need a merge first. The handrail is a square section swept along the helix with the section kept vertical, not a circular profile, and the balusters are square posts. Treads are flat slabs with no nosing profile. No building code check is made. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Annular sector solids with outward counter-clockwise winding
Helix sweep of a square section in the radial and vertical frame
Box projection UVs by dominant normal axis at one unit per metre
